title: Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account Spending and Balance Limits
content:
**Daily spending limits and the balance ceiling of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account.** Each is set per plan (Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential, Standard, Select, Advantage, Premier, Elite). Amounts are in US dollars, and daily limits apply per posted date.

| | Essential | Standard | Select | Advantage | Premier | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ATM cash withdrawals per day, amount | 500 | 500 | 600 | 800 | 1000 | 1000 |
| ATM cash withdrawals per day, count | 3 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 |
| Purchases per day, amount | 2500 | 2500 | 3000 | 4000 | 5000 | 5000 |
| Card-to-bank transfers per day, amount | 1000 | 1000 | 1500 | 2000 | 2500 | 3000 |
| Largest balance the account may hold | 10000 | 10000 | 12500 | 15000 | 15000 | 20000 |

## Reading the table

The ATM row has two parts, an amount and a count, both per posted date.

*Hypothetical reading:* on the Select plan, three ATM withdrawals totalling 450 on one posted date leave room for one more withdrawal of up to 150, within both 600 in amount and 4 in count.
